purpose: Correct the market-independent M3 structural top-3 probability for systematic front-position bias without changing M3 rank.
universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher; exact M3 validation universe

protocol.history: strictly prior starts only; up to 5 starts for position features
protocol.race_coherence: After correction, apply one common logit shift within each race so probabilities sum to exactly 3.0.

feature_definitions.base_logit: logit of M3 history-amount-corrected structural top-3 probability
feature_definitions.hist_front_mean: Mean normalized first-available-corner frontness over up to 5 strictly prior starts; higher means more forward.
feature_definitions.hist_cov5: min(number of strictly prior starts used for frontness,5)/5

runtime_guard.rule: Apply only when m3_history_amount_correction_v1 is actually applied and Finish600State contains the same race with hist_front_mean/hist_n inputs.
runtime_guard.reason: The correction was validated on top of the history-amount-corrected M3 probability. Applying it to a different baseline would be outside the validated protocol.

naming: Use 前方位置補正, not 逃げ残り補正.
caveats: Do not change M3 rank with this model.
Do not interpret the correction as a betting or value signal.
Escape/lead rate alone was not established as a reliable correction; this model uses general prior frontness instead.
Closing market already absorbs most of this information, so do not blend it into market probability without separate validation.
